item.title: Tech with Mak Your PDF parser can extract every word correctly and still give yo
item.description:
Tech with Mak
Your PDF parser can extract every word correctly and still give your AI the wrong information.

This is one of the most interesting engineering challenges in document AI.

A PDF isn't just text. It contains spatial relationships, tables, reading order, nested sections, and sometimes multiple unrelated documents bundled into one file.

Lose those relationships during parsing, and even a capable LLM can extract incorrect information with convincing confidence.

At production scale, solving this requires an entire processing pipeline:

→ Parsing to recover text, tables, layout, and reading order.

→ Splitting to identify boundaries between different documents.

→ Classification to determine document types and route them to appropriate workflows.

→ Extraction to convert relevant information into structured, typed fields.

→ Validation to check the output against schemas, business rules, and source evidence.

But accuracy is only half the engineering challenge.

Processing millions of pages means optimizing how much computation each stage requires. A clean digital invoice shouldn't necessarily consume the same resources as a poorly scanned, handwritten document.

This is why I find the recent work from Extend interesting.

Its document processing infrastructure now lists parsing at $2.50 per 1,000 pages and classification at $1 per 1,000 pages. This means that for $1 you can parse and split a 400 page document.

Those are individual processing stages, not complete extraction costs. But they illustrate how inexpensive the early stages of a document pipeline can become.

The engineering opportunity is to classify and route documents efficiently, reserve expensive models for difficult cases, and avoid unnecessary processing.

Of course, cheaper processing is only useful if it preserves accuracy. A classification error can select the wrong extraction schema. A splitting error can separate information that belongs together.

This is why production document AI needs to be evaluated beyond OCR accuracy and per-page pricing.

The metric worth optimizing is cost per correctly processed document, including retries, validation, and human review.

That's where accuracy, latency, and cost become one engineering problem.

As developers, we've always been told "good, fast, or cheap - pick two."

Well today, we're introducing Extend 2.5: better, faster, and cheaper document processing. Turns out, you can have all three.

- Parse: 60% cheaper, and up to 6.8x faster
- Classify Instant: sub-second classification at $1 per 1,000 pages
- Split: the cheapest and most accurate splitter on the market - Kushal Byatnal
tweet

item.title: Benson Sun 老黃回歸的第一件事： 把 Anthropic 的 GPU 訂單安排到 2074 年再交貨 https://t.co/kBA2XiIgSe
item.description:
Benson Sun
老黃回歸的第一件事：
把 Anthropic 的 GPU 訂單安排到 2074 年再交貨 https://t.co/kBA2XiIgSe

昨天 Anthropic 掛牌上市，收盤約 97 美元，完全稀釋市值約 1.8 兆美元。巧了，台積電現在的市值也差不多 1.8 兆。

同樣標價 1.8 兆，一邊是日進斗金的晶片製造霸主，一邊是 AI 時代最火熱的模型商龍頭，到底誰便宜、誰貴？

借《三國志》裡郭嘉「十勝十敗論」的講法，台積電對上 Anthropic，我們從五個維度來分析：

商業模式
從輝達、Google TPU 到 AMD，高階 AI 晶片都得找台積電代工。只要 AI 持續蓬勃發展，不管最後誰勝出，台積電都分得到一杯羹，而且淨利率超過五成。

Anthropic 就沒這麼好命了。就算 AI 真的大爆發，只要最後的贏家是 Gemini、OpenAI 或開源模型，Anthropic 能分到的就會大幅縮水，甚至可能根本賺不到錢。這一行到現在仍在燒錢搶市佔，連 OpenAI 單季營業虧損都還超過百億美元，就知道錢有多難賺。

此乃台積電一勝。

護城河
台積電贏的不只是技術，還有龐大的資本和蓋廠的物理時間。一座先進廠造價兩百億美元起跳，從建廠、裝機到把良率磨上來就是三到五年，不是有錢就追得上。三星和 Intel 砸了大錢還是卡關，就是最好的證明。

反觀做模型不用蓋廠，對手有錢租算力就能追。Anthropic 領先開源模型大約只有 4 到 6 個月，閉源陣營還有 Gemini 和 OpenAI 緊咬，等於每半年就要重考一次。一旦模型能力被追上，定價權和營收成長就會受到壓力

此乃台積電二勝。

收支結構
台積電的訂單極穩，客戶為了搶產能甚至願意先掏預付款，未來幾年的生意早就談定。

反觀 Anthropic，近八成營收按 Token 用量計費，大客戶多半沒有綁長約。用戶換個 API 就能跳槽，哪裡便宜好用就往哪裡去。且 Anthropic 自己跟雲端大廠、資料中心簽了約 9,000 億美元的算力合約，大部分是用不完也得照付。客戶隨時可能走人，算力帳單卻一毛都跑不掉。

此乃台積電三勝。

籌碼面
台積電幾乎是全流通股，籌碼乾淨。

Anthropic 則是典型的「低流通、高 FDV」VC 盤。上市初期能交易的股數只有約 13 億股，但招股書排了 23 個解禁日，一年內幾乎所有舊股都會陸續解禁，可流通籌碼最多將暴增到約 130 億股，足足膨脹 10 倍。現在追進去，等於直接站在一整年的解禁賣壓前面。

此乃台積電四勝。

估值安全邊際
台積電前瞻本益比不到 20 倍，就算明年成長不如預期，股價也有實打實的獲利撐著。

Anthropic 雖然成長飛快，但現在的股價已經 price in 了相當樂觀的成長劇本：就算明年營收如期衝上 1,350 億美元，市銷率（PS ratio）仍有約 13 倍。

萬一營收少個兩三成，市銷率會被拉高到 16 到 18 倍，而且市場會開始懷疑它還是不是高速成長股，不再願意給這麼高的倍數。遇上戴維斯雙殺，股價就得大幅下修，在 Morningstar 的悲觀情境裡，市值只剩 5,000 億美元。

此乃台積電五勝。

-----

所以總結下來，同樣標價 1.8 兆美元，要嘛台積電太便宜，要嘛 Anthropic 貴得離譜。

但晶圓代工是一個很成熟的產業，有很成熟的估值體系，所以我更傾向台積電的定價是合理的。如果台積電的定價是合理的，那 Anthropic 現在就真的太貴了。 - Benson Sun
tweet
